test_method: Godot GDScript calls against checked native batch and revision-guarded publication adapter
limitations: Only the isolated GDScript adapter publishes revisions and whole-texture updates; production DrawingDocument and UI are not exercised
Timings include Godot PackedByteArray copies and are not input-to-visible latency
Software runner only; no physical Windows/Linux hardware or GPU timings
Temporary binary is not bundled in the repository or loaded at normal startup
The optional publication GL witness uses Xvfb/Mesa software rendering and a single-threaded isolated adapter
Dirty bounds describe modified pixels; ImageTexture.update() reuploads the entire tile
